# Aviv Msika

Aviv Msika is a Social Media Manager and Creative Strategist who blends data-driven strategy with high-end visual storytelling. Operating as an end-to-end creative professional, Aviv handles everything from in-house content strategy to full production — including professional photography, video editing, and Reels/TikTok-style content. The brand exudes sophistication and artistry, targeting premium lifestyle, culinary, and e-commerce clients who demand polished, visually stunning digital presence. The aesthetic is minimalist and refined — beige, black, and white — evoking a luxury editorial feel.

Social Media Management & Creative Strategy



# Aviv Msika


Digital Strategist & Visual Maker


Aviv Msika is an end-to-end creative professional who bridges the gap between data-driven social media management and high-end visual production. With a background spanning digital marketing, professional photography, video editing, and Reels & TikTok-style content, Aviv takes every project from in-house strategy through to full production — delivering a cohesive, polished digital presence that performs as beautifully as it looks.


Specialising in social media management for premium lifestyle, culinary, and e-commerce brands, Aviv crafts content ecosystems that are simultaneously strategic and visually arresting. Every campaign is built with intent: audience insight, platform nuance, and editorial craft working in concert to grow communities and elevate brand identity.


"I believe the most compelling content lives at the intersection of analytical thinking and genuine artistry — where the numbers inform the vision, and the vision moves people."


Social Strategy
Photography
Video Editing
Reels & TikTok
Brand Identity





























Areas of Expertise


## What I Bringto Every Project


An end-to-end creative approach — from high-level strategy to hands-on production — built for brands that demand more than just content.









01




### Strategic Planning & Channel Direction


Every successful social presence begins with a clear strategic foundation. I develop tailored channel strategies rooted in audience insight, competitive analysis, and brand positioning — ensuring your content works harder across every platform. From content calendars and campaign architecture to tone-of-voice guidelines, I provide the roadmap that transforms creative output into measurable growth. This is social media management service elevated to true brand consultancy.


- Content Strategy

- Campaign Planning

- Platform Direction

- Brand Voice










02




### Photography & Visual Production


Visuals are your brand's first impression — and I shoot them in-house. Specialising in lifestyle, culinary, and product photography, I bring a refined editorial eye to every frame. From concept to camera, I handle the full production process: styling, lighting, composition, and capture. The result is a cohesive visual library that feels intentional, premium, and unmistakably yours.


- Lifestyle Photography

- Product Shoots

- Culinary & Food

- On-Location Production













03




### Editing, Delivery & Brand Consistency


Great content isn't just captured — it's crafted in post. I handle all video editing and retouching in-house, producing Reels, TikTok-style edits, and polished stills that perform across platforms. Every deliverable is calibrated to your brand's visual identity: consistent colour grading, typography, pacing, and tone. Whether managing a single campaign or an ongoing social media management strategy, I ensure every asset feels cohesive, considered, and on-brand.


- Video Editing

- Reels & TikTok

- Colour Grading

- Brand Consistency




















The Process


## From Concept toLaunch-Ready Content


A structured social media management service that transforms ideas into polished, high-impact content — every time.





Research & Planning Materials



brand audit ↗
content pillars
visual direction →
✦ final review












01




### Discover


We begin with a deep-dive into your brand — your audience, competitors, voice, and visual identity. This research phase uncovers what truly sets you apart and defines the strategic foundation for everything that follows.

Brand Audit · Audience Research






02




### Strategize


With insights in hand, a bespoke content strategy is crafted — defining content pillars, posting cadence, platform priorities, and campaign arcs. Every decision is data-informed and aligned with your business goals.

Content Strategy · Planning






03




### Produce


This is where strategy becomes art. From professional photography and Reels to branded graphics and video editing — all production is handled in-house, ensuring every asset is polished, on-brand, and visually stunning.

Photography · Video · Editing






04




### Refine


Post-launch, performance metrics guide continuous improvement. Engagement data, reach analytics, and audience feedback feed directly back into the strategy — keeping your content sharp, relevant, and always evolving.

Analytics · Optimisation









end-to-end creative management















Philosophy

## Content should earn its place.




I believe that great social media management is never accidental. Every frame, caption, and campaign should be intentional — built from a clear strategic foundation, shaped by a genuine understanding of the brand, and executed with the kind of visual discipline that makes people stop scrolling.



Artistry and commercial effectiveness are not opposites. When strategy and aesthetics move together, content doesn't just look beautiful — it performs. That's the standard I hold for every client, whether it's a single Reel or a full-scale content management service.

### Maison Dorée — Culinary Brand Launch


Developed a complete social media management strategy for a premium culinary brand entering the Israeli market. The campaign combined editorial food photography with short-form video storytelling, achieving a 340% increase in organic reach within 60 days. Every asset — from concept to caption — was produced in-house, maintaining a consistent luxury aesthetic across all touchpoints.

### Lumière Skincare — E-Commerce Growth


Crafted a full-funnel social media management service for a boutique skincare label, translating product science into aspirational visual narratives. The creative strategy focused on TikTok-native storytelling paired with polished grid curation on Instagram — resulting in a 5x ROAS on social-driven campaigns and a loyal community of 28K engaged followers built entirely through organic and boosted content.

# Trusted by Premium Brands


From boutique culinary studios to elevated e-commerce labels, Aviv partners with brands that lead with intention — delivering end-to-end social media management and creative strategy that turns presence into performance.






































































A selection of brands served across lifestyle, culinary, and e-commerce verticals.









Who I Work With

## Sectors I Serve



Thoughtful social media management and creative strategy tailored to the unique rhythms of three distinct worlds.













### High-End Lifestyle Brands


Luxury lifestyle brands demand more than polished imagery — they require a social media management service that understands aspiration, narrative, and restraint. Aviv crafts editorial content strategies that protect brand equity while building genuine community, turning followers into devoted advocates who embody the lifestyle you represent.


- Brand voice & tone development

- Editorial content calendars

- Aspirational visual storytelling














### Culinary Brands


Food is one of the most sensory-driven categories in social media — and one of the most competitive. Aviv brings an in-house photographer's eye to every culinary account, producing content that makes audiences stop mid-scroll. From intimate restaurant atmospheres to artisan product launches, the strategy is rooted in appetite and authenticity.


- In-house food & beverage photography

- Reels & short-form video production

- Campaign strategy & seasonal planning














### Premium E-commerce Businesses


For premium e-commerce brands, social media management platforms must do double duty — building desire and driving conversions. Aviv combines data-driven strategy with high-impact creative production to deliver content that performs. Every post is designed to feel premium, not promotional, keeping the brand elevated while moving product.


- Performance-focused content strategy

- Product photography & video editing

- End-to-end campaign execution

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/29/2026



Aviv Msika ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Aviv Msika

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 29, 2026



Aviv Msika is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Aviv Msika

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
